plainText:
Misty is one of the main characters of the Pokémon Newspaper Strip. She is based on from .

==Character==
Misty is a Pokémon Trainer, and also attends a regular school. She and her classmate Ash frequently lose their temper around each other and battle Pokémon. Misty lives in a house with a pool in the backyard. Her older sisters are , , and .

Misty has repeatedly stated that Ash's Pikachu should be kept in its Poké Ball. She doesn't mind that has the habit of flirting with women, except she gets upset when Brock flirts with her older sisters.

==History==
 
 
Misty debuted in , when Ash began attending as her classmate. After an announcement that Pokémon Trainers may bring their Pokémon to school only if they are not disruptive, Misty and Ash said that each other's Pokémon should not be allowed for that reason, respectively, and they started to battle.

In , Ash and Misty complimented each other for their maturity, because they hadn't been fighting lately. Ash said that his Pikachu would win against Misty's Horsea, and they started to battle again.

In , it was revealed that Ash caught Misty's Starmie by mistake, thinking it was .

In , Misty remarked that Ash's Pikachu should be kept in its Poké Ball. She and Ash also witnessed the battle of vs. Brock at school.

In , Misty showed Ash her , , , and . Ash asked why did she keep when she had so many powerful Pokémon. Psyduck's headache caused it to unleash a powerful explosion of energy, throwing Ash, Misty, and her Pokémon away. Despite that, Ash seemed unfazed and said that Psyduck is worthless. Misty agreed, and said that's why it needs her.

In , Misty guessed that the source of her Psyduck's headaches could be high blood pressure, or eye strain, or a brain tumor. All her guesses progressively scared Psyduck, until it unleashed another energy explosion, causing Misty to fall on the ground. As a last guess, Misty said that it could be anxiety.

In , Misty once again told Ash to keep his Pikachu in its Poké Ball. When Ash said that Pikachu won't obey, she insisted that Ash should command it. When Ash tried that, it shocked him instead of obeying him.

In , Misty said that Ash should catch "nice, trainable Pokémon" like her Staryu and Horsea. She also said that Ash doesn't have any "Poké-taste" and criticized his Pikachu, then Pikachu shocked her.

In , Misty told Ash that her Staryu evolved into a Starmie, and also bragged that it took "weeks of the most rigorous training imaginable", and that she was becoming a great Pokémon Trainer. She asked what Pokémon Ash had been evolving. Ash dejectedly replied that Snorlax seemed to be evolving into a sofa.

In , 's song caused Ash and Misty to sleep at school, and then it made drawing on their faces. Ash remarked that "there are worse things than being put to sleep", and Misty sarcastically agreed while looking annoyed at the drawings on his face.

In , Jigglypuff's song caused not only Ash and Misty, but also to sleep at school. An adult man commented on students sleeping at school, and an adult woman replied that she blames TV.

==Pokémon==
 

 

 

 

 

 

==Trivia==
Misty states her evolved into a in Strip 25. It is unknown if the strips occur in chronological unless otherwise stated as Staryu makes further appearances in the strips. It is unknown whether Misty owned two Staryu where one evolved into a Starmie or if the Staryu that appears is the same one that evolved.
